desc.zh: 用列与对角线集合剪枝，逐步撤销并保存所有完整棋盘。
desc.en: Prune with column and diagonal sets, undo each choice, and retain every complete board.

complexity: O(n·n! + S·n²) time; O(n) auxiliary + O(S·n²) output

concepts.name: Backtracking and constraint sets
concepts.description: Reject column and diagonal conflicts, restore the exact legal prefix.

concepts.name: Enumerating all N-Queens boards
concepts.description: Keep complete boards while undoing working placements.
